pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Small bug fix with one reasonable design (escape wildcards). The change matches the PR words. It adds no new options.
No spec file in the change.
New tests cover %, _ and backslash literals, and each would fail without the escaping. `npm test` could not run here because vitest is not installed.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. No docs describe search wildcards.
The escape regex and `ESCAPE '\\'` are consistent, and the backslash is escaped first via a single-pass replace. Parameters stay bound.
The query stays parameterized. The escaping removes unintended wildcard matching.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
